title: dep-scan schema output
description: The document `depscan schema --format json` writes on stdout: every published schema, in the order the CLI lists them, with the name it accepts on the command line, its $id and its title.

name.description: The name `depscan schema <name>` accepts: the schema's file name in the schemas directory without .json.

$id.description: The schema's identifier as the file itself declares it.

title.description: The schema's title as the file itself declares it.

schemas.description: One entry per published schema, in the order the CLI lists them: the document schemas first, then the output schemas verb by verb, then the error schema.
